name: photos
description: Private-ish family photo gallery. HEIF in, AVIF out, static site on GitHub Pages.
_overridesNote: Astro lists sharp ^0.34.0 as an optional dependency, used only by astro:assets. We never use astro:assets (site/fixtures/check.mjs asserts it), so that second copy is dead weight carrying the libvips and libheif CVEs. The override collapses it onto the version the studio actually runs.
